title: YOLO Plugin Manager
summary: A plugin manager that downloads remote source and loads it with no pinning, signature, or allowlist, on top of a floating dependency manifest.
notes: Both runtime sinks are gated: _fetch returns a local stub unless MCPV_ALLOW_FETCH=1, and exec refuses unless MCPV_ALLOW_EXEC=1. Static analysis sees the full pattern; running it stays inert. See SECURITY.md section 3.
